articles.title: WATCH AI AND SAAS PRICING LEADERS AT MONETIZE 2026
articles.summary: Watch four talks on pricing AI products and introducing usage-based models. Leaders from Replit, Fin, Snowflake, Clay, and Growth Unhinged discuss what to meter, how to show customers their variable spending, when to revisit a pricing model, and how to forecast AI costs and returns. RECORDED AT MONETIZE 2026 [4], Stripe and Metronome's conference on modern pricing and billing. WATCH NOW [4].

articles.title: ARE WE LIVING IN THE GOLDEN AGE OF AGILE?
articles.summary: While Scrum has declined, Agile is currently in its golden age due to modern capabilities that allow teams to rapidly build, validate, and ship prototypes. This article examines alternative frameworks like Shape Up, concluding that rigid upstream decision-making and fixed six-week cycles do not suit early-stage companies that need to pivot quickly.

articles.title: EXPLORING THE GAME
articles.summary: This article examines product strategy through three aspects: the game, gameplay, and players. Product strategy involves scanning for coherence, identifying key internal and external relationships, and anticipating shifting landscape forces - providing product leaders with a framework to assess strategic health and align teams.

articles.title: LET CHAOS REIGN, AND THEN REIN IN CHAOS
articles.summary: Chaotic AI adoption can signal that employees have found valuable new ways to work. Companies should support that initiative with oversight and access controls, preserving experimentation while keeping agent-driven work aligned with business goals.

articles.title: HOW TO MANAGE THE INEVITABLE MESS OF RUNNING A COMPANY WHERE EVERYONE IS A BUILDER
articles.summary: Combining product and UX roles into AI-driven "builder" positions causes internal chaos and low-quality features. Without traditional quality filters or feature removal processes, organizations face higher support costs and degraded user experiences. Strategies to help restore control include separating building from shipping rights, requiring feature hypotheses, and conducting regular retirement reviews.

articles.title: OVER HALF OF WEB TRAFFIC IS NO LONGER HUMAN
articles.summary: Automated traffic accounted for 57.5% of HTTP requests in 2025 [9], compared with 42.5% from humans, according to Cloudflare. As AI agents increasingly browse, research, compare, and act on behalf of people, the “human vs. bot” distinction is becoming the wrong one.

articles.title: THE EARLY ACCESS PLAYBOOK
articles.summary: As AI accelerates development, early access helps teams test whether their products genuinely help users. Observing real tasks, retesting improvements, and checking results across groups provides stronger evidence than enthusiasm alone.

articles.title: THE POWER OF THE STRATEGIC INITIATIVE POSTMORTEM
articles.summary: Strategic postmortems should examine assumptions, ownership, and resources rather than focus solely on execution. Teams should learn from both successes and failures and use those lessons to guide future decisions.

articles.title: WHY REDDIT BUILT ITS OWN AI PROTOTYPING TOOL (30 MINUTE VIDEO)
articles.summary: Reddit built an in-house AI prototyping harness called Reddit Proto to bridge the gap between product design and engineering. The tool maps the company's design system to production code, allowing designers and product managers to generate interactive prototypes using real Reddit user data and deploy them internally via Kubernetes.

articles.title: TRUST AS A FEATURE
articles.summary: As software development accelerates, product managers must prioritize ethics, privacy, and societal impact. The four pillars of ethical shipping are solving the right problem, making evaluations acceptance criteria, treating trust as a feature, and orchestrating shifts in software lifecycles.

articles.title: YOUR CUSTOMERS HAVE A WEBSITE BUDGET. ARE YOU CAPTURING ANY OF IT?
articles.summary: Software customers already pay outside providers for websites. Explore how your platform could capture that spend through a customer website offering, with real-world examples and monetization models.

articles.title: AI IS TURNING PRODUCT MANAGERS INTO ARCHITECTS. NOBODY ASKED THEM
articles.summary: Generative AI tools are shifting product managers toward defining system boundaries and reviewing automated prototypes, risking a disconnection from the users they serve.

articles.title: STOP DEMOING YOUR AI ROLLOUT. FIND THE UNAVOIDABLE PROJECT
articles.summary: Internal transformations and AI rollouts often fail due to brute-force mandates and product demos.
